eligibleEmployees.description: The number of eligible eligible Employees

totalRevenue.description: Sum of all plans revenue for the sponsor

totalCommission.description: Sum of all plans commissions for the sponsor

totalFees.description: Sum of all plans fees for the sponsor

totalPremium.description: Sum of all plans premiums for the sponsor

name.description: Name of the administrator who filed the Form 5500

phoneNumber.description: Phone number of the administrator who filed the Form 5500

largestLineOfBusiness.description: Text description of the plan which is the largest benefit line of business, by revenue

parent.description: The parent or normalized lead insurance carrier, normally due to acquisition or corporate ownership

name.description: The largest service provider for the benefit plans

service.description: Description of the service provided by the largest service providers (e.g. Claims Administration)

totalRevenue.description: Revenue associated with the largest service provider

currentRetireesReceivingBenefits.description: Number of current retirees receiving benefits

futureRetireesReceivingBenefits.description: Number of future retirees receiving benefits

isSelfFunded.description: True/False indicator if the benefit plan is self-funded

isCollectiveBargained.description: True/False indicator if the benefit plans are collectively bargained

isMegaWrap.description: True/False indicator if the company uses a mega-wrap to combine benefits under one plan

isFirstFiling.description: True/False indicator if this is the first filing for this company

isDelinquentFiling.description: True/False indicator if this is a delinquent filing

isFinalFiling.description: True/False indicator if this is the final filing for this organization

isExtensionFiled.description: True/False indicator if this organization filed an extension

preparerName.description: Text field containing the name of the preparer, if any

hasMultipleEmployer.description: True/False indicator if this organization filed as a multiemployer/multiple employer benefit plan

hasScheduleA.description: True/False indicator if a filing has no schedule A, but has a 5500

state.description: Standardized and normalized state (2 letter abbreviation)

county.description: The county name of the broker address

name.description: The lead broker for employee benefits plans by revenue amount

parent.description: The parent or normalized name of the lead broker, normally due to acquisition

name.description: The secondary broker for employee benefits plans by revenue amount

id.description: The unique identifier of a company. If the response id differs from the requested one, it indicates that the requested company has been acquired, and the data of the parent company is returned instead.
